source: Hand-written synthetic public twin of the F8 VoicEra transcript export. Written only from the structure documented in docs/phase1/SCOPE.md (Format of F8) and docs/adr/0018-real-sample-mapping-policy.md (Decision 6). No real call, person or text was read, copied or adapted; the dialogue is invented (a made-up library opening-hours helpline).

scenario.language: mr (Devanagari) with Latin-script fragments inside one user turn

software.vendor_export_version: unknown: the export is the user's report of VoicEra's standard export and is not verified in VoicEra documentation (ADR 0018 Decision 6)
software.generator: none: typed by hand and checked with the F8 parser of the tests

structure_documented.message_lines: [ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with milliseconds and +00:00] assistant|user: text
structure_documented.assistant_line_may_concatenate_utterance: the last assistant line repeats one prompt and adds a closing message
structure_documented.turns_may_mix_scripts: one user line holds Devanagari and Latin-script words
structure_documented.file_name_carries_local_time_ist: the file name is the first line's time in IST (UTC+05:30); content is UTC; the name is never used for timing

non_derivation_statement: The twin was built from the documented structure only. CI cannot prove that it shares no text with the real call (it never sees the real call); the local-only test test_no_private_text_in_committable_files checks word 8-grams when the real file is present, and review attention covers the rest.

call_2026-10-24_11-01-07_c0ffee01.txt.description: F8 VoicEra-style transcript export, 10 message lines (5 assistant, 5 user), LF line endings, final newline, no BOM
